tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is a cool, frost-tinted paper; dark is a forest at night — never pure white or black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets that sit on frost: commitment cards, milestone cards, recap cards.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells below the surface: input fields, stepper tracks, future days on the calendar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only — never the sole cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: unchecked checkboxes, input outlines, the missed-day ring. 3:1 or better on frost and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on frost, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — dates, units, captions — on frost, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: evergreen
tokens.usage: The brand. Primary actions, complete days, a done commitment. As text, legible on frost, surface, sunken and evergreen-soft.

tokens.name: evergreen-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind evergreen text: selected chips, a completed card's wash.

tokens.name: on-evergreen
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an evergreen fill — the primary button's label. Never plain white in dark.

tokens.name: larch
tokens.usage: Accent, after the larch that turns gold in autumn. Milestones, the today marker, partial days. As text, legible on frost, surface and larch-soft.

tokens.name: larch-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind larch text: the milestone card, a partial day's wash.

tokens.name: missed
tokens.usage: A missed day or failed arc. Honest, not alarming — always paired with a hollow ring, never colour alone. Legible as text on frost and surface.

tokens.name: rest
tokens.usage: A rest day: a sanctioned pause, not a failure. Always paired with the small-dot mark. Legible as text on frost and surface.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in frost, then a 2px ring. An alias of evergreen, so it follows the theme.

groups.name: App voice
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque, a variable grotesque with an optical-size axis: expressive at display sizes, calm at small ones. Everything the app says — labels, numbers, headings — is in this family.

styles.name: ss-display
styles.usage: The one big number on a screen: the day count on Today, the headline on a recap card.

styles.name: ss-title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the arc's name.

styles.name: ss-body
styles.sample: Three of four done. Reading is left.

styles.name: ss-label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, tags and form labels.

styles.name: ss-caption
styles.usage: Dates, units and the small print under a number.

groups.name: Your voice
groups.note: Literata, a reading serif. Only for words the user wrote themselves — intention, reflections, notes. The app never speaks in it.

styles.name: ss-voice
styles.sample: I want to finish this winter stronger than I started it.
styles.usage: The day-1 intention, milestone reflections and day notes, wherever they are quoted back.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside a control: icon to label, number to unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related items: a title and its caption, chips in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen margins and the gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Breathing room around a display number or a recap card's headline.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, chips, input fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets — soft, like a worn field notebook.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, the day-state discs and the stepper buttons.
